name: arogya-sahayak
description: Arogya Sahayak: a rural telemedicine platform connecting patients, village health assistants (Sahayaks) and doctors.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

author: Sachin Kumar
